description: Test fixture corpus for casr provider readers, writers, and round-trip tests.

cc_simple.intent: Basic 4-message conversation with all fields populated.

cc_complex.intent: Tool use/result content blocks, content arrays, file-history-snapshot skip.

cc_missing_workspace.intent: Session with no cwd field. Tests workspace=None path.

cc_unicode.intent: Japanese, Chinese, and emoji characters. Tests UTF-8 fidelity.

cc_malformed.intent: Malformed JSON lines interspersed with valid messages. Tests error tolerance.

codex_modern.intent: Modern JSONL envelope with session_meta, event_msg, response_item.

codex_legacy.intent: Legacy single-JSON format with session and items keys.

codex_token_count.intent: Includes token_count events that should be skipped as non-conversational.

codex_reasoning.intent: Agent reasoning events extracted as Assistant messages with author=reasoning.

codex_malformed.intent: Malformed lines interspersed with valid Codex entries. Tests error tolerance.

gmi_simple.intent: Basic Gemini session with user/model message types.

gmi_grounding.intent: Grounding metadata and citations in model responses. Tests extra field preservation.

gmi_missing_workspace.intent: No workspace inferrable from content. Tests workspace=None.

gmi_gemini_role.intent: Uses 'gemini' role type instead of 'model'. Tests normalize_role mapping.

gmi_jsonl_rewind.intent: Current Gemini JSONL: header, $set metadata updates, a message re-appended under an id already recorded, a $rewindTo that undoes two turns, and one record type this reader does not recognise. Proves the reader folds the log instead of concatenating it.

agy_simple.intent: Antigravity (agy) conversation. uuid==db filename stem; content read from sibling brain/<uuid>/.system_generated/logs/transcript.jsonl. Tests housekeeping-step drop, USER_REQUEST unwrap, tool-call extraction, model pin, and gmi disambiguation.

grok_simple.intent: Grok Build (grok CLI) session: ACP session-update stream in updates.jsonl + summary.json metadata under sessions/<percent-encoded-cwd>/<uuid>/. Envelope and user_message_chunk/hook_execution/retry_state shapes captured from a real grok 0.2.103 session (sanitized); assistant/tool shapes per the public ACP schema. Tests chunk coalescing, tool_call+tool_call_update merge, unknown-kind tolerance, and summary-driven title/model/workspace.

cline_simple.intent: Basic Cline task fixture with API conversation history and taskHistory metadata.

amp_simple.intent: Basic Amp centralized thread fixture with workspace and timestamp metadata.

aider_simple.intent: Basic Aider markdown history fixture with model/workspace metadata lines.

chatgpt_simple.intent: ChatGPT mapping-format conversation with parent chain. Float timestamps, model_slug metadata.

clawdbot_simple.intent: Real @mariozechner/pi-coding-agent SessionManager transcript — the envelope every published clawdbot writes (clawdbot depends on that package and drives the file via SessionManager.open/appendMessage). Header, message entries with text/thinking/toolCall blocks and a toolResult, plus a model_change.
clawdbot_simple.provenance: Generated by the published @mariozechner/pi-coding-agent@0.32.3 SessionManager itself, driven exactly as clawdbot drives it (SessionManager.open on a not-yet-existing file, then the header stamp from dist/agents/pi-embedded-runner/session-manager-init.js). Only the wall clock was frozen, so the timestamps are stable; entry ids are the real randomUUID().slice(0,8) values. Not hand-written.

vibe_simple.intent: Basic Vibe JSONL conversation with role/content/timestamp fields.

factory_simple.intent: Factory JSONL with session_start header and typed message entries. Model from message.model.

openclaw_simple.intent: Real @openclaw/ai SessionManager transcript. Covers the record types that separate OpenClaw's fork from pi: session_info, an entry-level custom_message, a bashExecution message (no `content` field), thinking blocks carrying `.thinking`, a toolResult, a custom entry, and a branch_summary produced by an actual rewind — so the file contains an abandoned branch that a linear read would resurrect.
openclaw_simple.provenance: Generated by the published openclaw@2026.7.1-2 SessionManager itself (which vendors @openclaw/ai@2026.7.1-2, not @mariozechner/pi-coding-agent), driven through its own append API: appendMessage / appendCustomMessageEntry / appendCustomEntry / appendModelChange / appendThinkingLevelChange / appendSessionInfo / branchWithSummary. Only the wall clock was frozen, so entry timestamps are stable; entry ids are the real randomUUID().slice(0,8) values and the header id is a real uuidv7. Not hand-written. The previous fixture at this path was synthetic and encoded casr's expectations rather than OpenClaw's output: it stamped `version` as the string "0.1.0" where OpenClaw stamps the number 3, used sequential m1/m2 ids, and carried no `parentId` on any entry, so it could not express the tree the format is built on.

piagent_simple.intent: Pi-Agent JSONL with session header, toolResult role, and toolCall blocks. Underscore filename.

cur_simple.intent: Cursor state.vscdb SQLite with modern v0.40+ format. 4-message conversation with workspace in bubble.

opc_simple.intent: OpenCode SQLite with sessions+messages tables. 4-message session with model metadata.

edge_empty_content_cc.intent: Empty and whitespace-only content messages that should be skipped.

edge_null_timestamps_cc.intent: All messages lack timestamps. Tests None timestamp handling.

edge_long_message_cc.intent: Very long message body (900+ chars). Tests no-truncation preservation.

edge_single_sided_cc.intent: User-only messages, no assistant. Validation should flag as error.
